description: Scans with a scan count of exactly 11 are kept.

d.request: Include scans with `scancount` ≥ 11 that have a matching site; group by `scans.zoneref` and `sites.phasefactor`, calculate unrounded averages of non-null `scancount` and `pressratio`, and return the 10 groups with the highest average compression ratio, placing groups with a null average compression ratio last.
d.sql:
SELECT s.zoneref, st.phasefactor, AVG(s.scancount) AS avg_scancount, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio
FROM scans AS s
JOIN sites AS st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
WHERE s.scancount >= 11
GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.phasefactor
ORDER BY avg_pressratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

a.request: Join scans to their sites on `scans.zoneref` = `sites.zoneregistry`, dropping unmatched scans. Keep only scans whose `scancount` is at least 11. Group by site code (`scans.zoneref`) and historical phase (`sites.phasefactor`). For each group, give the site code, the phase, the average `scancount` and the average compression ratio (`pressratio`), each ignoring missing values. Sort by average compression ratio, highest first with missing last, keep the first 10 rows, and don't round.
a.sql:
SELECT scans.zoneref AS site_code, sites.phasefactor AS historical_phase, AVG(scans.scancount) AS avg_scancount, AVG(scans.pressratio) AS avg_compression_ratio
FROM scans
JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry
WHERE scans.scancount >= 11
GROUP BY scans.zoneref, sites.phasefactor
ORDER BY avg_compression_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

b.request: Include scans with `scancount` ≥ 11, join them to sites by `scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry` and exclude scans without a matching site; group by site code and historical phase; calculate unrounded averages of nonmissing `scancount` and `pressratio`; return the 10 groups with the highest average compression ratio, placing missing values last.
b.sql:
SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, st.phasefactor AS historical_phase, AVG(s.scancount) AS avg_scancount, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio
FROM scans AS s
JOIN sites AS st ON s.zoneref = st.zoneregistry
WHERE s.scancount >= 11
GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.phasefactor
ORDER BY avg_pressratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
b.raw: Include scans with `scancount` ≥ 11, join them to sites by `scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry` and exclude scans without a matching site; group by site code and historical phase; calculate unrounded averages of nonmissing `scancount` and `pressratio`; return the 10 groups with the highest average compression ratio, placing missing values last.

c.request: For scans whose `scancount` clears the 11-scan mark, linked to their sites through `scans.zoneref` = `sites.zoneregistry` (scans without a site left out), what are the average `scancount` and the average compression ratio (`pressratio`) for each site code (`scans.zoneref`) and historical phase (`sites.phasefactor`)? Ignore missing values and don't round. Show the site code, the phase and both averages for the 10 combinations with the highest average compression ratio, with missing values last. Scans with a scan count of exactly 11 are kept.
c.sql:
SELECT scans.zoneref, sites.phasefactor, AVG(scans.scancount) AS avg_scancount, AVG(scans.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio
FROM scans
JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry
WHERE scans.scancount >= 11
GROUP BY scans.zoneref, sites.phasefactor
ORDER BY avg_pressratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
